# Third-party frontend assets

PeerTrain stores the following frontend dependencies locally so that application
pages do not depend on third-party CDNs at runtime.

| Dependency | Version | Source | Licence |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Bootstrap | 5.3.7 | https://getbootstrap.com/ | MIT |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.13.1 | https://icons.getbootstrap.com/ | MIT |
| Chart.js | 4.5.0 | https://www.chartjs.org/ | MIT |
| Plus Jakarta Sans via Fontsource | 5.2.8 package | https://fontsource.org/fonts/plus-jakarta-sans | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

The corresponding licence text is stored beside each dependency.
